claims.statement: For finite bipartite H, W subseteq V(H), a=alpha(H), and 1<=k<=a, tagged independent-set counts satisfy k*q_(k+1)<=2*(a-k)*q_k.
claims.scope: All finite bipartite simple H, including disconnected graphs and empty W, with integer 1<=k<=alpha(H).
claims.reason: The deletion-extension incidence count and bipartite color-class bound close every stated case, including k=a and empty W.

claims.statement: For bipartite G with an original leaf v and p>=1, 3p>=2alpha(G)+1 implies Delta_(p-1)(H_v)-Delta_(p-1)(R_v)<=0.
claims.scope: All finite bipartite simple G with a degree-one vertex in G; integer p>=1 under the explicit high-tail guard; no selector or residual premise.
claims.reason: The tagged-count binding and rank arithmetic are exact; p=1 forces G=K2, while p>=2 follows from C2-T3-01 or zero extension.

claims.reason: The exact Delta_0, Delta_1, Delta_2 arguments exclude alpha=4,5,6, including the n=7 star and n=8 two-vertex-cover boundaries.

claims.statement: Every eligible ordinary connected tree has nonpositive complete favorable original-leaf sum at p=alpha(T)-2.
